scope: Independent read-only source/native-contract/acceptance sufficiency review. No edit, build, GPU or runtime.

findings.issue: Boundary records cannot establish required post-fight outcome. Pose omits damage, experience/promotions, movement and coordinates; command/fight returns only log RNG/rules with pose=None,args=zeros. A destroyed participant is not explicitly distinguished from an unreadable record at completion.
findings.required_before_paired_outcome_acceptanc: Use separately reviewed fixed read-only participant snapshots at entry/return, including stable identity and distinct present/absent/read-failed/reused states, or a separate exact native outcome audit for each matched arm.

findings.issue: FightEnter records raw defender pointer, but command samples only attacker and watch merely registers defender afterward. No guaranteed stable actual defender ID event exists if no observed later selector/tick reads that defender. Raw pointers cannot be compared across fresh sessions as native defender identity.
findings.required_before_paired_outcome_acceptanc: Record and preserve actual attacker/defender stable IDs before original fight; do not infer defender98 from the offline stack.

findings.issue: select::install_at_start does not enforce only the displayed exact5-byte selector prologue: existing hook machinery accepts any leading E9 and installs over its target. Existing tick guard likewise permits E9. This preserves an existing chain but is weaker than an exact loaded selector/tick gate.
findings.required_for_exact_gate_claim: Explicitly reject unreviewed entry jumps or bind/audit the actual accepted runtime targets. Exact RNG loaded42/32/21-byte gates remain valid independently.

safety_review: Feature is default-off and explicit path required; failed audited runtime leaves capture disabled. Optional sha2/file IO occurs only during install, before capture.

No RNG getter, reseed, native simulation/audio/global state write added by observer. Reads use direct32-bit seed0xA52674 and toggle-rule0xA5263C, with explicit RngReadFailed and capture read_failed on failure.

Selector/fight/move wrappers forward original arguments/results and use existing thiscall-compatible fastcall adapters. RNG boundary sample precedes pose reads. Diagnostic scope is declared before existing guards, so return sample follows native call and guard retirement. No RefCell borrow crosses original native call.

Tick/selector hot paths use fixed stack reads, fixed arrays and preallocated8192 Event storage; overflow invalidates capture and does not grow it. No explicit Mutex, channel, sleep, new wait, log, formatting or file IO is added during active capture. Existing production camera barrier remains unchanged in purpose.

Native unit/animation owner checks use unit+0x27c, animation+0x134, nonnegative ID and checked ID-to-pointer lookup. Existing drawn_unit_at reads a fixed stack record and invokes no calculated native getter.

Events use one Instant epoch per native command thread. Timestamping and records describe hook observations, not physical UI dispatch or scanout. First diagnostic allocation is before depth is raised; flush/format/IO occurs after outer return and depth0.
what_boundary_data_can_prove: For valid nonoverflowing capture with read_failed=false, CommandEnter/Return and FightEnter/Return rng_rules=Some provide observed complete native seed DWORD and toggleable-rules DWORD at those exact hooked boundaries. Paired equal pre/post values establish observed seed/rule-word equality for those finite trials.

Require full toggle-word equality and preserve bit0x100, identical intended command/stable participants and same pinned save/runtime/rules fixture. This word alone is not full combat-rule or initial unit-state equivalence.

Equal boundary seed values do not count RNG calls or rule out a full-period cycle, and current observer lacks outcome snapshots. It cannot independently prove equal post-fight outcome or exact command-to-idle duration.
test_and_runtime_limits: Owner check-verdict reports i686 feature-off/on checks and3 Linux pure observer tests. This independent review executed neither build nor tests and does not convert metadata checks into native ABI or PE runtime acceptance.
Known-participant read failures, overflow, missing capture/gates, flush failure, missing boundary metadata or unmatched native scopes must leave the arm invalid/not observed.

No accepted viewer frame containing first pose is emitted by this native module; join separate accepted-frame/serial evidence. No physical scanout or timing acceptance inferred from native timestamps.
Army displayed-child poses are not automatically added by watch beyond registered top-level participants. Planned Warrior fixture is narrower; broader army capture requires separate coverage audit.
coordination: Concrete outcome/defender/gate gaps sent directly to army_units at root instruction. Owner is designing an isolated successor with fixed native snapshots and exact entry checks; that unbuilt/unreviewed successor is not covered by this review.
decision: No new observer simulation/RNG/audio mutation or active-capture allocation/locking defect found in reviewed source. Current candidate remains insufficient alone for planned full1x/4x outcome/RNG acceptance because of identified data/gate gaps. Nonshipping only; no runtime acceptance.
